content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization, the retro-authorization window is closed, no peer-to-peer is offered, and a necessity appeal has already been attempted. Because CO-197 is a contractual denial rather than an adjudicated deductible amount, the balance is not properly billable to the patient despite the remaining deductible; no payer or secondary path remains.","action":"write_off"}
